item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.9)
item.description:
**Nightly build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Fixes

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.8)
item.description:
**Nightly build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Fixes
- Future versions stay connected even when the phone and the Mac run different Deepsync versions: a message one app doesn't know is skipped instead of dropping the connection
- The Mac and the phone say when the other one should be updated
- Phone: the "update available" reminder comes back a day after you dismiss it, as a notification or when you open the app

### Note
- A phone on staging 5 can't stay connected to a Mac on staging 6 or newer. Update the phone app.

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.7)
item.description:
**Nightly build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Fixes
- Mac and phone music no longer pause each other: while another app plays on the phone, the Mac's card steps back and the Mac keeps playing (#33)
- Switching the Mac's sound from the audio driver to "phone" or "Mac and phone" no longer gives garbled, phone-only audio (#32)
- Back on Wi-Fi after Tailscale while Mac audio is playing, the phone now moves to the faster Wi-Fi connection
- Opening Deepsync no longer asks for the Mac password when Unlock from Phone is on
- Unlock from Phone after an update: unlock with your password once and allow Deepsync, instead of a prompt nobody can answer at the lock screen
- Copying big images no longer freezes the app on the phone or the Mac
- A burst of phone notifications no longer stalls the Mac menu bar

### Security
- Phone remote control only starts after you approve mirroring
- Only adb can open the phone's USB screen-share screens
- Safer app updater downloads
- Limits on incoming folder transfers
- Bluetooth fallback no longer drops healthy connections on network changes

### Smaller
- Less idle battery and CPU use (Mac Bluetooth, USB screen-share frames)

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.5)
item.description:
**Staging build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Changes
- Make the HyperOS volume-panel Mac slider experimental and off by default
- Fix QR pairing in release builds: keep ML Kit component registrars
- Fix cold-start crash: declare media-session sync lock before init
- Android: send screen/Wi-Fi power state to the core; drop core debug logs in release
- core: power-aware reconnect, LAN probe, mDNS browser and logging (phone battery/data)

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.4)
item.description:
**Staging build** (a release build that may still have bugs).

### New: control whatever is playing on the Mac
- One **Playing on Mac** card for any app (Spotify, YouTube in Safari or Chrome, podcasts, Apple Music), with the app's name on it.
- When an app can't skip tracks (most browsers), **−10 s / +10 s** replace previous/next.
- Apple Music keeps lyrics. The Mac sound card is now just volume and output.
- The phone's media controls (notification and lock screen) follow the same app.

### Fixes
- Android 12: the in-app updater no longer crashes when Android asks to confirm the update.
- Release notes in the update screen are formatted properly.

### Updating
- **From staging 3:** use the in-app update (Mac: menu bar › Check for Updates…; Android: Settings › Updates).
- **From older builds, or on Android 12:** install this one by hand, once.

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.3)
item.description:
**Staging build** (a release build that may still have bugs).

### New: updates inside the app
This is the last version you install by hand. From now on:
- **Mac:** Deepsync checks for updates by itself. You can also use menu bar icon › right-click › **Check for Updates…**, or Settings › Updates.
- **Android:** Settings › **Updates** › Check for updates. A notification and a Home banner appear when a new version is out. The first update asks you to allow "Install unknown apps" for Deepsync once.
- Staging builds get staging updates. Turn off **Get beta (staging) updates** to only get full releases.

### Install
**Mac** (Apple silicon, macOS 26+): open the DMG and drag Deepsync into Applications. On first open: System Settings › Privacy & Security › **Open Anyway**.

**Android** (Android 12+): Play Protect blocks apps that read notifications when they don't come from the Play Store. Turn off Play Store › profile › Play Protect › ⚙️ › **Scan apps with Play Protect**, install the APK, then turn it back on. If Notification access is greyed out: Settings › Apps › Deepsync › ⋮ › **Allow restricted settings**.

Pair: Mac › Deepsync › Pair phone, then phone › Scan QR code.
